name: Duality of object and material
description: Represents how an object and a portion of matter are the same material entity seen two ways: as material (steel) it bears chemical composition; as object (ingot) it bears mass. Distinguishes extensive qualities, which scale with the size of the object, from intensive qualities, which are independent of portion size.
competency_questions: Which material is this object made of? Which qualities does an entity bear as a portion of matter (chemical composition) versus as an object (mass)? Which of an entity's qualities scale with its size and which do not?
